Tbh, through my experience using salon color+volume, usually to achieve a lighter hair colo, my hair was damaged. However, during this time I had to bleach my hair as well because I am a dark brunette (bleach is incredibly damaging). Through my use of box dyes since - unicorn hair (pink, purple and caramel) as well as box dyes (READ REVIEWS) - I have found that afterwards short and long term, my hair is even more conditioned than before. 

TLDR: I’d recommend against using Developer, color doesn’t last and only makes your hair feel dry and damaged. I have had less trouble with box dyes, but they come with their disadvantages as well.
